name: Watermelon UI
summary: Free MIT open-source React animated components, blocks, and dashboards.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 131 animated-components (catalog also lists components/blocks/dashboards/templates — not fully ingested).
Registry also mirrored at https://ui.watermelon.sh/r/{name}.json; catalog prefers canonical registry.watermelon.sh.
Optional @watermelon-ui/cli exists for MCP client init; component install remains shadcn registry URL.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Dock
components.summary: macOS-style dock with cursor-driven icon scaling and hover interactions.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://registry.watermelon.sh/r/dock.json

import { Dock } from "@/components/watermelon/dock"

<Dock />

copyPrompt.text: Use Watermelon UI free MIT component `Dock` (slug `dock`) from https://ui.watermelon.sh/animated-components/dock. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://registry.watermelon.sh/r/dock.json` (official Watermelon shadcn registry). Imports land under `@/components/watermelon/dock` as `Dock`. Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind; Motion peers as listed in registry. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WatermelonCorp/watermelon-platform/main/LICENSE). Pricing free — open-source community components/blocks.
